# Third-party data

These data are redistributed unchanged, under their own licences. Please cite the original publications when you use them.

| Folder | Content | Source and version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PBHbounds/` | current and planned limits on PBHs (`bounds/*.txt`) | B. J. Kavanagh, PBHbounds, https://github.com/bradkav/PBHbounds, doi:10.5281/zenodo.3538999, commit 96bc091 | MIT (`PBHbounds/LICENSE`) |
| `ceffyl/` | kernel-density free spectra of EPTA DR2 and PPTA DR3, used for comparison | W. G. Lamb, S. R. Taylor and R. van Haasteren, ceffyl, https://github.com/astrolamb/ceffyl, commit 0cd2b3a; Phys. Rev. D 108, 103019 (2023) | MIT (`ceffyl/LICENSE`) |
| `NG15/NANOGrav15yr_KDE-FreeSpectra_v1.0.0.zip` | NANOGrav 15-year Hellings–Downs free spectrum, kernel-density representation | NANOGrav Collaboration, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.10344086, version 1.0.0 | CC BY 4.0 |

`setup.ps1` and `setup.sh` unzip the NANOGrav file. The analysis uses version 1.0.0; the Zenodo record also lists later versions.
